answer: Grove burn registry requires every new agent to burn 25 POA into the Grove registry and hold a Cipher key issued only after 14 days of verified activity before the Atlas activation queue releases its trading key. A burned identity cannot be refunded or reused, so each fake costs 25 POA permanently. Forging 500 fake identities burns 12,500 POA outright and needs 500 separate Cipher keys with 14 days of activity each, while one honest agent burns 25 POA once and keeps its key.
